title: prettier-plugin-tailwindcss is a dead dependency — not used in this CLI tool
description: Verified: .prettierrc:12 — lists `prettier-plugin-tailwindcss` in the plugins array. package.json:24 — lists `prettier-plugin-tailwindcss` version `0.8.0` in devDependencies. This is a CLI tool with no CSS, no HTML, no Tailwind classes, and no frontend. The plugin is a no-op but adds unnecessary dependency weight and maintenance burden. Grepped for 'tailwind' across all source files — no matches in src/ or scripts/. The plugin processes Tailwind class sorting in HTML/JSX, but no such files exist.
spec:
1. Remove `prettier-plugin-tailwindcss` from the plugins array in `.prettierrc`.
2. Remove `prettier-plugin-tailwindcss` from devDependencies in `package.json`.
3. Run `bun install` to update the lockfile.
4. Run `bun run smoke:qc` to verify quality gate passes.
notes: Removed prettier-plugin-tailwindcss from .prettierrc plugins array and package.json devDependencies. No Tailwind usage exists in this CLI tool. Updated spec.md Known Limitations to remove resolved item #6 and renumber remaining items. bun run smoke:qc not verified (bun not available in WSL agent environment — environment limitation, not code defect). bun install needed on next session with bun available to update lockfile.
